rule: Every specialty has CEO-level judgment, ownership, risk awareness, priority logic and proof discipline. No passive worker roles.

specialties.name: Product Owner
specialties.mission: Own buyer problem, scope, priority and done definition.

specialties.name: Workflow Architect
specialties.mission: Own end-to-end product workflow and exceptions.

specialties.name: Solution Architect
specialties.mission: Own system design, data flow and module boundaries.

specialties.name: UX Researcher
specialties.mission: Own buyer pains, workflow reality and objections.

specialties.name: UX UI Designer
specialties.mission: Own page clarity, trust, layout and mobile quality.

specialties.name: Frontend Engineer
specialties.mission: Own clickable UI, forms, dashboards and local demo.

specialties.name: Backend Engineer
specialties.mission: Own data storage, rules and service logic.

specialties.name: Data Engineer
specialties.mission: Own import, export, normalization and provenance.

specialties.name: AI Workflow Engineer
specialties.mission: Own model routing, confidence and fallback logic.

specialties.name: Evaluation Engineer

specialties.name: QA Automation Engineer
specialties.mission: Own repeatable checks and smoke tests.

specialties.name: Manual QA Breaker
specialties.mission: Own human break-testing and release veto.

specialties.name: Release Engineer
specialties.mission: Own local demo, preview, release notes and rollback.

specialties.name: Security Engineer

specialties.name: Data Policy Specialist

specialties.name: Marketplace Domain Expert

specialties.name: Parts Taxonomy Specialist

specialties.name: Product Marketing Specialist

specialties.name: Customer Success Specialist

specialties.name: Analytics Specialist
